entries.description: Read project-guidance, prerequisite change-log, dabbler-uat-dsl source surface (CLI Program.cs, schema, grammar, SuppressionMatcher); confirmed catalog has schemaVersion 1.1 with isWatermarked field, schema/component-catalog.json file is at v1.0 (no isWatermarked) — doc will describe v1.1 contract per spec.
Authored dabbler-uat-dsl/docs/language-reference.md (closed verb list, structured VERIFY forms, scope rules, watermark synchronization, locator rules, closed-list extension policy, worked example).

Authored dabbler-uat-dsl/docs/cli-reference.md (validate/compile flags, JSON output shapes, exit codes, ValidationErrorKind table, --active-role + AnyRole sentinel notes, common workflows, known limitations).
Authored dabbler-uat-dsl/docs/data-contracts.md (catalog schema 1.0/1.1 with isWatermarked, suppressions schema with match algorithm, round-trip contract diagram).
Updated dabbler-uat-dsl/README.md with Documentation section linking the three new docs and dabbler-platform/COMPATIBILITY.md, plus a How-this-fits-in pointer back to the AI-led workflow.
Created dabbler-platform/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md with current supported combination table (Core 1.2.0 / Cli 1.2.1 / Emitters 1.1.0 / catalog 1.1) and bump procedure.

Refactored project-guidance.md Catalog-Grounded UAT Checklist Authoring + closed-verb-list Conventions to link to dabbler-uat-dsl docs instead of restating verb syntax + CLI flags. Integration commentary (watermark pairing rule, W2 runner role-inference, click-driven-cursor known limitation) retained in dabbler-platform.

dotnet build clean (0 errors, 184 warnings — all pre-existing CS0618 obsolete + CS8604 nullable from prior sets); 709/709 non-Playwright unit/integration/bUnit tests pass (Components 43, Security.Blazor 200, Api 27, Reports.Blazor 16, Security 300, Web 123). Doc-only set, no code change expected to affect tests.

Cross-provider verification: gemini-pro tier 2 ($0.0313, 25s) — flagged Three-Step Discipline collapse but that is Session 2 Step 4 work per spec; disposition: VERIFIED for Session 1, false positive (out of scope). Note: first call landed on tier-3 Opus (same-provider, $1.24 wasted, known router penalty); re-routed with max_tier=2 to force cross-provider. Verifier returned narrative instead of required JSON block — verifier-format observation tracked in session-001.md.

Read project-guidance, lessons-learned, session-set-authoring-guide, platform addendum, ai-led-session-workflow, Session 1 review + activity log; reviewed Session 1 disposition and the spec's Step-9 reorg notes for Session 2 work.

Updated docs/ai-led-session-workflow.md: added new "UAT/E2E pipeline (the DSL-driven path)" section with 4-stage flow (uat-script-author -> W0 compile -> W2 runner -> human UAT); added "Migration: from manual *UatCoverageTests.cs pairing to the DSL pipeline" sub-section; refactored "E2E Coverage Before UAT" to describe structural parity; removed uat-coverage-review row from Task Types table; rewrote Rule #11; mirrored retirement in template-seed/docs/ai-led-session-workflow.md.

Updated docs/planning/session-set-authoring-guide.md: requiresUAT field semantics describe DSL pipeline; deliverables list updated to W0-compiled test; spec template snippet adds requiresE2E DSL-pipeline shape pointing to uat-script-author + W0 compile + W2 runner. Updated docs/planning/session-set-authoring-guide.platform-addendum.md: E2E test location notes W0-compiled output; W0 toolchain doc reference added; requiresE2E heuristic refers to DSL pipeline.

Collapsed the Three-Step UAT Authoring Discipline Convention into a single paragraph pointing at the workflow doc's pipeline section. Collapsed the Step-block alignment Convention (legacy pattern noted as closed-sets-only). Refactored the Playwright pre-testing convention into "Compiled-test proof per UAT item" + "Authoring goes through the router" (uat-script-author). Updated Human UAT Philosophy bullets to describe structural parity. Adjusted the UAT/E2E DSL sibling-repo references intro for the new pipeline.

Removed uat-coverage-review from ai-router/router-config.yaml in 5 places: task_type_overrides, delegation.always_route_task_types, task_type_params, complexity.task_type_scores, verification.auto_verify_task_types. Added retirement note next to remaining uat-plan-generation entry. Verified ai_router.config.load_config() succeeds; uat-coverage-review absent from task_type_scores and _task_templates.
Added migration note to top of ai-router/prompt-templates/task-prompts.md explaining the retirement and the DSL pipeline replacement. Deleted the # uat-coverage-review section.

End-to-end coherence audit handled directly per human direction (no routed call). Verified the chain CLAUDE.md -> workflow doc -> authoring guide -> addendum -> project-guidance -> router-config -> task-prompts tells one consistent story. Updated 2 open spec references (sensitive-field-masking-audit-uat-remediation, unified-master-details-composite) per the spec's scope-creep risk note. Closed-set artifacts (lessons-learned entries, scripts, closed specs, router-metrics.jsonl) intentionally preserved as historical.

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln clean (0 errors, 184 warnings — all pre-existing CS0618 obsolete + CS8604 nullable from prior sets, identical baseline to Session 1). Full unit test run skipped — pure docs/config set; Session 1 confirmed 709/709 pass on identical surface.

Cross-provider session-verification routed to gemini-pro (tier 2, max_tier=2 to force cross-provider) per human direction. Verdict: VERIFIED, 0 issues, "all Session 2 objectives are met"; cross-checked spec-compliance, internal coherence, closed-set preservation, open-set coherence, and migration-note clarity. Format note: verifier used JSON key "status" instead of schema-required "verdict" but otherwise followed the schema; semantically unambiguous so accepted as-is (no orchestrator disposition required).

Authored change-log.md directly per human direction (no routing). Captured per-session deliverables (sibling-repo docs from Session 1; workflow rail edits + uat-coverage-review retirement from Session 2; two open-spec migrations; intentionally-preserved historical artifacts). Next-set recommendation authored directly (also per human direction): sensitive-field-masking-audit-uat-remediation as the natural first consumer of the newly-aligned rails, with transactional-system-columns gated on its UAT.

Step 9 reorganization review (post-notify): No reorganization commit needed. Candidate A (cross-repo doc-placement lesson) does not meet the two-context promotion threshold yet (one application context — Session 1 of this set). Candidates B (uat-coverage-review Convention bullets) and C (Three-Step UAT Authoring Discipline collapse) are reorg-review confirmation only — already covered by Session 2 Steps 4-6 in the main commit.
